escalation_note: ⚠ ONE ESCALATION THAT MATTERS BEYOND THIS RECORD — the p2 line 3 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' cell. At full-page resolution the handwriting reads as '$3446' with no visible separator, and that is how it was captured in the earlier cover-totals tranche (this module's published stated_beginning_balance for this filing is 3446). A 1200 dpi tight crop (pct:57,58.5,18,6.5@p2) resolves a decimal point between the '34' and the '46', and THE LADDER SETTLES IT REGARDLESS: line 5 'Subtotal (Add lines 3 and 4)' is printed as $1,500.00 and line 4 is 1,465.54, so line 3 can only be 34.46 — 3,446 would make line 5 read 4,911.54. ARITHMETIC CLOSURE OUTRANKS GLYPH READING (GOTCHAS, the Rhodes reversal): the beginning balance is 34.46. This is reported to the coordinator as a candidate correction to the published cover figure; nothing outside this record was edited. Second escalation: a 700 dpi crop (pct:57,75,18,12@p2) rendered line 6 as '$1,500.00' and line 7 as a single hand-drawn ZERO GLYPH — an oval with a diagonal stroke through it — which under the zero-glyph ruling reads 0 and closes the ladder.
